item.title: POV: Getting Your Husband Ready for Family Christmas
item.description: With family Christmas approaching, Tammin Sursok has a checklist for her husband, from replacing his holey socks and fixing his clothes to making sure he looks presentable. Eighteen years together and the job isn't done!

item.title: Mean Girl Behavior Has No Place in Adulthood
item.description: Grown women making fun of other women on social media is giving high school mean girl energy. It's time to leave the judgment and public ridicule behind.

item.title: When Your Friend Talks With Their Eyes Off the Road
item.description: Tammin Sursok rides with that one friend who keeps turning to make eye contact while talking, leaving the passenger wondering if they should be watching the road instead.
